scope: Qt developed-plate window, original unfolding integration, local plate layout, error display, section curves, complete boundary exports and scaled print output.
notes: The complete plate suite is current with the installed source; it contains independent original-core fixtures and mathematical checks, an independent DXF reader, and physical PDF scale measurements.
The basic migration regression preceded only plate-specific project color and label contrast changes. The actual installed basic editing workflow was then rechecked directly.
Geometry still uses Pascal unfolding. This does not complete the remaining native core migration.
Hidden Windows Qt widgets and image/PDF inspection do not replace desktop mouse, focus, multi-monitor or physical printer acceptance.
Connected symmetric plate halves retain separate closed DXF outlines and their common centreline. Exports are not deduplicated CAM cutting paths.
Automatic nesting, material forming allowances and manufacturing certification remain outside this delivery.
All test and diagnostic sources are retained under FreeShip-Tests and integrated in the qt-plates suite.
Legacy fs, QtPilot, user models and existing preferences were not replaced.
